data.description:
## Description

**What**: /dso:brainstorm conditional load gated by A2's project-level detection (STRATA_DETECTED=yes + STRATA_TEMPLATE_KIND=rails + strata.skip != true). When gated open, Reads concepts.md + guidance/brainstorm.md at Phase 1 Step 1 (≤80 lines). During Phase 1 Gate Step 2, if STRATA_UNCERTAINTY binary signal fires (capability-verification cannot be answered from concepts.md alone), on-demand Reads decomposition.md. At Phase 2 Step 2, brainstorm sets strata:scoped tag on epic based on its structural fit assessment. Tag UX disclosure: visible inline message on tag set/unset with override path. Tag lifecycle symmetric (set + unset paths via re-runs). Read-after-write fence: brainstorm waits for tickets-branch commit before exit.
**Why**: Brainstorm is the gateway — sets the tag that downstream skills inherit; tag write must be durable before exit.
**Scope**:
- IN: Phase 1 Step 1 conditional Read; Phase 1 Gate Step 2 STRATA_UNCERTAINTY on-demand load; Phase 2 Step 2 tag set/unset with assessment; UX disclosure message; correction path; read-after-write fence.
- OUT: Preplanning/implementation-plan loads (separate stories); regeneration tool (separate story).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, on a Strata Rails project at Phase 1 Step 1, brainstorm Reads concepts.md + brainstorm-guidance.md totaling ≤80 lines ← Satisfies: SC2, SC3
- When complete, when STRATA_UNCERTAINTY fires, decomposition.md is on-demand Read ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, brainstorm sets strata:scoped tag on epics for SDK-shaped inputs and unsets for non-SDK ← Satisfies: SC3
- When complete, UX disclosure printed on set/unset; correction path documented ← Satisfies: SC3
- When complete, brainstorm waits for tickets-branch commit before exit (read-after-write fence) ← Satisfies: behavioral guarantee cross-skill-consistency
- When complete, dialog-content assertion: SDK-shaped input produces SDK-aware brainstorm output offering both SDK and non-SDK approaches ← Satisfies: SC3
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for the conditional + tag set/unset paths

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Tag UX disclosure prevents silent fit assessment
- [Reliability] Read-after-write fence ensures preplanning sees the tag

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As /dso:brainstorm, conditional load + tag set/unset with UX disclosure + read-after-write fence
